# Security Policy

Filament Agents lets a language model read and, with approval or a write token, change data inside a Filament panel. Please report anything that lets it do more than the signed-in person could do by hand.

If you discover a security issue, email [support@packstub.dev](mailto:support@packstub.dev) instead of using the issue tracker. We answer within a few days and credit reporters in the changelog unless they prefer otherwise.

The threat model, the trust boundaries and what the package does about prompt injection are described in [docs/security.md](../docs/security.md).
